items.title: official program page
items.claim: Hedera still visibly links an Apply Now route and names ambassador work and non-cash recognition.

items.title: official program page
items.claim: Cyfrin still invites applications and publishes its review period, work and non-cash benefits.

items.title: official announcement
items.claim: Soneium still explicitly says applications are open and links its Typeform.

items.title: official program page
items.claim: Elk still visibly links an application and states that the selected apprentice is a volunteer during its trial.

items.title: official documentation
items.claim: Nomis still directs prospective ambassadors to a sign-up form and describes referral-linked reward terms.

items.title: issuer program page
items.claim: Torium still labels applications open and publishes review-dependent USDT thresholds beginning at 50K verified views for $100.

items.title: official program page
items.claim: Nexo still displays a contact form, senior-fit requirements, salary language and incentive language.

items.title: official community program page
items.claim: Oasis still links a Become a Sentinel form and describes global meetup, content and representation work plus bounties, mentorship and early access.

items.title: company-linked job post
items.claim: Fiber’s company-linked post still describes flexible remote contractor work with monthly compensation and possible revenue share whose terms are discussed with selected candidates.

items.title: official support article
items.claim: Bitget’s Trading Builder recruitment remains dated 12 Jun to 30 Sep 2026 and publishes its audience, trading and shared-pool conditions.

items.title: official program page
items.claim: Solana still displays application fields while its published 1 Sep close date remains passed.

items.title: official program page
items.claim: PIVX still says positions are referral-only.

items.title: official program page
items.claim: SideShift still says applications are currently closed.

items.title: official program page
items.claim: Bybit says applications are open on a rolling basis for enrolled university or college students in six named African countries and links an application form.

items.title: official program page
items.claim: HeLa asks people to apply now, describes global Developer and Community tracks, a six-month term and token, NFT and perk rewards rather than fixed salary.

items.title: official program page
items.claim: Pendulum directs prospective ambassadors to claim a Discord role and says the position is not paid.

items.title: issuer announcement
items.claim: Wager Predict says applications are open but retains unfinished reward and regional-priority placeholders and says mainnet is pending an audit.

items.title: government consumer-protection guidance
items.claim: The FTC says a purported crypto job that requires an advance crypto payment is a scam.

items.title: government public-service alert
items.claim: The FBI warns about fake task jobs that require cryptocurrency deposits to unlock work.

items.title: security research report
items.claim: Recorded Future documented Web3 scam campaigns that used purported ambassador, marketer or Web3-developer recruiting claims before directing targets toward downloads.

items.title: official announcement page
items.claim: Aster’s announcement text did not render in the latest prior check, so its row remains dated 14 Sep.

items.title: Cronos Ambassador documentation
items.claim: Cronos documentation links a Season 3 form and describes contributor tracks for creators, educators, community operators and advocates.

items.title: Cronos Announcements
items.claim: Cronos’s official announcement channel describes Season 3 as five contribution tracks with XP, early app access and regional events.

items.title: Crypto.com Ambassador Privacy Notice
items.claim: The issuer’s notice says selected ambassadors may later be asked for identity documentation, including a photo and passport details.

items.title: Cronos participant discussion
items.claim: One self-identified participant says task submissions are reviewed before XP approval; this does not establish issuer terms.

items.title: Zerion Community
items.claim: Zerion links an ambassador form, says review is rolling with quarterly decisions, and states there is no ambassador salary.

items.title: Injective Ambassador Program
items.claim: Injective says creators, organizers, developers and educators can apply through a Zealy route and earn INJ rewards based on contribution impact.

items.title: Arc Architects overview
items.claim: Arc calls Architects its ambassador program but says it is not application-based; it uses contribution points and later role opportunities.

items.title: Arc Architects terms
items.claim: Arc says account registration does not guarantee participation and Architects are independent participants, not employees or agents.

items.title: BNB Chain Martian Application 2025
items.claim: The form linked by BNB Chain’s 2025 Martians post returned 404 in the 19 Sep check.

items.title: Stellar Ambassadors
items.claim: Rise In’s Stellar partner page visibly says applications are open and selection is ongoing; it names five countries, three tracks, proof of work and a trial.

items.title: Midnight Nightforce
items.claim: Midnight visibly links Apply Now and describes Nightforce as a volunteer program that is not for immediate financial rewards.

items.title: Thrilld Labs Ambassadorship
items.claim: Thrilld invites applications from global Web3 professionals and says compensation depends on participation and KPI-tracked achievements without publishing an amount or KPI.

items.title: Stellar Ambassador Program
items.claim: Stellar’s source-of-truth documentation says SAP 2.0 uses country-focused chapters and directs people who want to join a regional chapter to an ambassador intake form.
